title: Animated ASCII Art for Web Pages
summary: ASCII.rest is a web-based tool and API that enables developers to easily create and embed animated ASCII art into their web pages. The service provides a simple interface for generating animated text effects using ASCII characters, making it accessible for developers of all skill levels to add retro-style visual effects to their projects.
problem_solved: It simplifies the process of creating and displaying animated ASCII art on websites, eliminating the need for complex custom animations.
why_valuable: It adds a unique retro aesthetic appeal to web projects with minimal coding effort, appealing to developers who want to create nostalgic or playful visual experiences.
